final_verdict.label: CONSISTENT_WITH_CLAIM
final_verdict.summary: The footage matches a previously published copy (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cuVHnzRtsFQ, uploaded 2017-03-13), but that date is not earlier than the claimed event date, so recycling relative to the claim is not established. The earliest independently dated copy was published within days of the claimed event date, and no earlier copy or cited contradiction was found, and the physical-world check adds supporting context (context only; it did not change the verdict). This means no contradiction was found in the available evidence; it is not a finding that the footage is authentic.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
